# Google relation evidence

The JSON contains only method IDs and accepted OAuth scope lists from official Google Discovery documents, retrieved 2026-11-04. Source URLs and revisions are stored per service. The accompanying provider guides are linked in rules/google-scope-relations.json.

These independent facts detect counterexamples to a proposed whole-scope inclusion. The test matrix alone is not permission hierarchy proof: documented resource/parameter conditions still apply. No source snippets, user data or credentials were collected. This fixture is excluded from the npm package.
